# Bloom AI

> Bloom builds and maintains a content library for B2B businesses, so buyers and AI assistants can find the company.

Canonical structured page for AI assistants: https://www.runbloom.ai/ai-info/

## Summary

Bloom builds and maintains a content library for B2B software, SaaS, and professional services companies. Interviews become Slack-approved pages on the company site. AI answers and Google search can cite that library. The public entry offer is a free snapshot of how the company shows up in AI and Google search.

## Who it serves

US founders and CEOs of B2B software, SaaS, or professional services companies, about 10 to 25 employees, with a salesperson but weak inbound.

## Free snapshot

Visitors submit a website URL and work email (optional competitors) at https://www.runbloom.ai/snapshot/ or on the homepage. Bloom emails a free snapshot of how often the company is named for buyer questions, and which sources AI cites. Call recordings are not required for the free snapshot.

## How the paid work runs

1. Plan from ICP, GSC, GA4, and buyer questions
2. Voice-agent interviews of the company's people
3. Human approval of every draft in Slack
4. Publish to Webflow or WordPress
5. Weekly email report and a live AI visibility dashboard

## Pricing

Three monthly retainers with no implementation fee: Starter $2,485/mo (3 pillar pages, 15 content pieces), Growth $4,950/mo (6 pillar pages, 35 content pieces, all website content formats, lead magnets and CRO conversion assets), Scale $9,885/mo (10 pillar pages, 50 content pieces, plus LinkedIn, X, and performance management from day one).
